method: Row-level adjudications made by hand in Mandate 7 after reading the cited source. Each entry either (a) closes the row's leads as accounted-for, (b) records a subfeature loss that changes the row's evidence, or (c) records a reclassification. 'verifiedBy' names the file:line read to decide.

contractGaps._method: One entry per distinct client path that did not resolve to a registered operation at revision 8a6e03bb. 'kind' separates a wrong URL (the capability exists under another contract) from a missing backend capability. 'clientBehaviour' records what the user actually sees.

/admin/employer-applications/{X}/verify.evidence: backend/index.js:6440-6475 — optimistic concurrency (409 ADMIN_TARGET_CHANGED), self-review block, Firebase claims + token revocation, audit action EMPLOYER_APPLICATION_REVIEWED.
/admin/employer-applications/{X}/verify.clientBehaviour: `.catch(() => {})` then local status flip and toast 'approved & verified badge assigned' / 'rejected. Reason logged to security audit ledger.' Neither happens; no request ever succeeds.
/admin/employer-applications/{X}/verify.payloadMismatch: client sends {decision:'APPROVED'}; the real API accepts {status:'approved'}

/admin/jobs/{X}/moderate.evidence: backend/index.js:6886-6908 — status allowlist active|pending|inactive|archived, featured toggle, moderateJob with expectedStatus/expectedFeatured.
/admin/jobs/{X}/moderate.clientBehaviour: `.catch(() => {})` then local status flip to 'flagged' and toast 'status updated to SPAM / FLAGGED'.
/admin/jobs/{X}/moderate.payloadMismatch: client sends {isSpam, status:'flagged'}; 'flagged' is not an allowed status

/admin/users/{X}/status.clientBehaviour: `.catch(() => {})` then setUsers(status=SUSPENDED/ACTIVE) and toast. Account is not suspended; an administrator is told it is.

/admin/operations/backup.clientBehaviour: `.catch(() => {})` then lastBackup='Just now (Verified OK)' and 'MariaDB hot backup snapshot completed successfully.'

/admin/operations/cache-clear.evidence: No cache-invalidation route exists in backend/ (grep for cache/purge routes returns nothing).
/admin/operations/cache-clear.clientBehaviour: `.catch(() => {})` then 'Application route and model caches purged across nodes.'

/admin/queues.evidence: routes/platform.js:465. The client calls the correct path first and only falls back to /admin/queues when it rejects, so this site is dead code on the failure path, not the primary read.
/admin/queues.clientBehaviour: none visible while the primary call succeeds

/admin/queues/{X}/retry.clientBehaviour: primary call first; fallback only on failure

/admin/queues/dead-letter-queue/retry.evidence: routes/platform.js:504; bulk dead-letter replay is deliberately forbidden (routes/databaseAdmin.js:157 returns 400 BULK_REPLAY_FORBIDDEN).
/admin/queues/dead-letter-queue/retry.clientBehaviour: primary call first; fallback only on failure. If both fail the function still shows 'successfully re-dispatched' and rewrites the row to QUEUED.

/admin/queues/dead-letter-queue/purge.equivalentOperation: POST /api/platform/queues/purge is registered but answers 410 CLIENT_PURGE_RETIRED-style refusal (routes/platform.js:543); individual replay is the sanctioned path.
/admin/queues/dead-letter-queue/purge.evidence: routes/platform.js:543 returns 410; no purge operation exists.
/admin/queues/dead-letter-queue/purge.clientBehaviour: `.catch(() => {})` then removes the job from state and reports 'purged from outbox records'

/api/billing/validate-coupon.evidence: backend/index.js:4597 — full validation (format, existence, active, expiry, max uses, per-user redemption).
/api/billing/validate-coupon.clientBehaviour: axios().catch(() => null) then a hardcoded list (SAVE20 20 %, WELCOME50 50 %, PROMO10 10 %, LAUNCH100 100 %) is applied locally. The server re-validates couponCode at order creation (paymentActivation.applyServerCoupon:71-101), so an invented code is rejected with 400 INVALID_COUPON and checkout fails — the displayed discount is never honoured, but no discount is granted either.
/api/billing/validate-coupon.securityNote: client-side promo constants are not exploitable for a discount because the server recomputes the amount; they are a pricing-integrity/UX defect only. Stated explicitly so the finding is not inflated.

/api/platform/status.clientBehaviour: enterpriseRequest rejects; caller must surface it (not swallowed at the call site)

/jobs.evidence: routes/jobsData.js:159 — public listing with query filters, publicOnly scoping, isPubliclyVisibleJob filter; mounted at /api/jobs-data (index.js:515).
/jobs.clientBehaviour: the public job board's only data call fails; the page renders its error state instead of listings

/blog/posts.alsoCalledAs: POST /blog/posts from pages/blog/editor.tsx:149 — no POST /api/admin/blog/posts exists at all; creation is an upsert through POST /api/blog-data/:id (routes/blogData.js:96) where the client must supply the id. New-article save therefore cannot succeed under either contract.

/blog/posts/{X}.equivalentOperation: GET /api/blog-data/:id or /api/blog-data/slug/:slug; update via PATCH /api/admin/blog/posts/:postId or POST /api/blog-data/:id
/blog/posts/{X}.clientBehaviour: editor cannot load an existing post; save path reports failure or silently no-ops
/blog/posts/{X}.alsoCalledAs: DELETE /blog/posts/{X} from AdminBlogManagementTab.tsx:126 — the equivalent operation exists (DELETE /api/admin/blog/posts/:postId at backend/index.js:3408; DELETE /api/blog-data/:id at routes/blogData.js:106), but the client path is dead and the failure is swallowed: `.catch(() => {})`, row removed from local state, 'Article … deleted successfully.' The article stays published. falseSuccess=true for that site; severity P1.

/notify/email.evidence: No route matches. The 11 client notification dispatches are retired to 410 (index.js:419-424, :7203) and /api/notify/email is not among them, so it falls through to the zero-trust policy and never reaches a handler. The email service itself (services/emailNotifier.js, imported at index.js:14) has zero call sites in the whole backend — orphaned, not merely unscanned.
/notify/email.clientBehaviour: swallowed twice: `.catch(() => { /* Fallback: log notification to application record */ })` (the comment describes a fallback that does not exist) and then the outer `catch` sets messageSuccess(true) as well. The recruiter sees 'Message Dispatched!' for a request that 404s.
/notify/email.note: The rejection reason is persisted through the application status API; only the email dispatch is absent. Employer-to-candidate email is not implemented anywhere server-side.

/support/tickets.evidence: Registered all along; absent from the V5 register because of the receiver defect (DISC-041).

/admin/support/tickets.clientBehaviour: works, with one residue: the loader keeps its fixtures when the real list is empty (DISC-048)
